title: Rediscovering The Leadership Attitude of Kings Part 2
paragraphs: Rediscovering the attitudes that create the leader within you and that set you apart from your followers. And last night we were trying to lay a foundation, because I wanted to make sure that everyone in this conference understood that we were all created to be leaders, but not necessarily to be leaders of people. And one of the challenges we face in today's world is that our philosophy of leadership was created by the Greeks and Romans, rather than by Christ.

When I went to college, which was a Christian college in Tulsa, I was shocked to learn as a first- year student that the first required text on my book list was a work by Plato. It was a required text. Every university does that. Honestly, I don't think there's a single one of you sitting in this room who graduated from university and has n't had to read the writings of Aristotle, Plato, or Socrates.

The reason for this is that our entire society, all our universities, all our philosophical ideas come from Greek philosophy. I sat there reading the books and writings of these great philosophers and discovered that their ideas are the foundation of our social, cultural, and political environment. For example, it was the Greeks who introduced the word ' democratic'. It was born in Greece. It became an idea or ideology that created our current system of governance. This is a Greek system of government.

This is called democracy. It didn't come from the Bible. It comes from Greece. The Romans conquered the Greeks. And the Romans became the most powerful government in the world. They created such a powerful army that no country in the then known world could defend itself against Rome. The Romans were a fascinating people. The Greeks were philosophers, but the Romans were utilitarians. This means that the Greeks talked about it, the Romans implemented it. The Romans did not destroy Greek philosophy. They saved it.

In fact, they protected the libraries of the Greeks. And the Romans adopted Greek philosophy and created their leadership philosophy. There are five specific principles of Greek philosophy regarding leadership that were adopted by the Romans. It is important to understand that the Romans still exist today. When Rome fell, what we call Europe was born from it. Europe is a fragmented form of Rome. The Romans ruled from England to Africa.

Thus, all the nations of Europe, from England to Africa, have survived on the philosophical foundations of Greek philosophy, which the Romans exported. And the Romans taught, they ruled, and they controlled the thinking of the world. In my book, Becoming a Leader, a copy of which I hope you have received, I have written a few chapters on Greek philosophy and titled them " Leadership Misconceptions." Misconception. Because in my opinion, Greek philosophy was a misconception when compared to the Bible.

For example, the Greeks had a belief that some people are born to lead, and some people are born to follow. So, if you belong to the class that was born to follow, no matter how much education or degree you acquire, they concluded that you would forever remain a slave. This was Greek philosophy. The Romans adopted it. Second, the Greeks believed that leadership was the result of innate traits. According to the Greeks, it was innate that some people were born with certain characteristics that made them leaders.

The rest of us, who did not possess those characteristics, would have been forever confined to the slave population. This was Greek philosophy. The Romans believed it. And that's why the Romans believed that some people were born with certain traits and that they were the founders of their so-called Aryan race, which is a Roman term. Hitler also adopted the same ideology. That's why he killed people. Because to him they were not fully human. Well, remember that Europe was a fragmented form of Rome itself.

So, when the imperialist powers began to expand, they even reached America. The Romans settled in America. Which later breaks. So there was no problem in bringing in slaves, because they were not born with those characteristics. As a result, people were considered inferior at that time. The word 'sub' means lower. And so, slavery was quite natural and spontaneous. Because you were not born with those characteristics. And the Aryan race was characterized by golden hair, blue eyes, and a nose like the Romans.

So, if you did n't have fair skin, blue eyes, and blonde hair, you would automatically be considered an inferior person. So, you understand, there was no hope for me. And so, 200 years ago, it was natural for American culture to not consider African people as fully human. This was a Greek philosophy exported by the Romans, which broke down when it arrived in Europe. Did I explain clearly? When Jesus came to earth 2,000 years ago, he was empowered by that vision.

The Romans ruled the world at the time of Jesus' birth. Therefore, Jesus Christ was automatically considered an inferior person to a Roman. The Bible says, he was born under the law, under the law. He was born in a small town called Bethlehem in Palestine. He grew up in a village called Nazareth, which had only one street and eleven houses.

Therefore, these people of Palestine were considered inferior, and that is why the Romans could control them, tax them, and force them to carry shields and swords whenever they pleased. After all, they were born solely to serve the greater nation. Jesus knew that the disciples had grown up in this environment. He knew that they had been trained in that environment. So, when he chose them, he knew they were tainted by the idea of ​​leadership.

So, one of the things he said to them is what we hope to discuss on Wednesday. When they started competing for leadership, they started fighting for positions. Because remember, the Greek philosophy was that the gods chose you to be a leader. This was Greek philosophy. In other words, the gods would choose who would be leaders and who would be slaves. The Romans believed it, the Greeks believed it, and so Europe believes it too. The disciples had a problem. They believed it too.

And so, one of the philosophies of Greek leadership theory was that leadership is the result of charismatic personality. This is a Greek philosophy. In fact, the word ' charisma' means, in the plural, the gift of the gods. Charisma is a Greek word. It meant those who were gifted by the gods. So, if you were gifted by the gods, you would automatically be included in the leadership class. If you did not have the gifts of the gods, you would automatically be considered a slave and a subjugated person.

And from there, human worship originated. That was the ultimate stage of humanism. In fact, the Greeks worshipped the human body as the most valuable and highest quality product on the planet. In a sense, they were the inventors of humanism. The Romans adopted it. Therefore, the Romans also believed that they were the superior people. They had gifts from the gods. In fact, Caesar believed he was the son of the gods.

Many of you who have read history know that the Pharaohs believed in the idea that humans are children of God, and the Romans believed in it. And so the idea was that God had given gifts to the world through these people and they were leaders according to the laws of the gods, so you couldn't resist the leaders. If you rebelled against Caesar, if you rebelled against Pharaoh, you rebelled against the gods and therefore you deserved the death penalty. I want you to think about the problems of leadership.

Those philosophies still exist today. That's why the first book you're allowed to read in college is Greek philosophy, not the Bible. The biblical concept of leadership is the complete opposite. In fact, Jesus said these words when the disciples were trying to become Greek. They were trying to fight for dominance. Fight for position. Fight for position. In fact, two of them, James and John, were so adamant about this that they sent their mother to talk to him about it.

And they begged their mother to tell him to make them sit at the highest positions on the right and left sides of his kingdom. And he was a little shocked by their audacity. His answer to them was, " Do you know what you want?" Very interesting question. I think everyone in this room would like to get promoted. All people have a desire to be in charge. They do n't tell you. They do n't reveal it. That's why those ten people were angry, if you remember the story. They weren't angry with those two. Why?

It's not because they did n't want the positions. They were angry because they had occupied the positions before them. Every human being has the desire to be great. I repeat, every human being has the desire to be great. Many of them don't talk about it, but they think about it all day long. You think so too. Because the desire for greatness is natural. Please write it down. The desire for greatness is natural. Even a slave wants to be a master. But he doesn't talk about it. No one likes to be oppressed. No one.

Even the oppressed do not want to be oppressed. We all have the desire to be great. We have the desire to dominate. And what's amazing to me is that Jesus didn't condemn this desire to be great. In fact, his response to their strong desire for leadership was positive. He did not scold them. James and John had the right attitude. Their desire was also correct. What they didn't understand was the process. They wanted the positions to be handed over to them.

If Jesus Christ is the Christ and if He is God, then He should be the one to appoint them as leaders. After all, the Romans believed the same thing. The gods have given humans the talent to be leaders. Therefore, they were trying to gain leadership through divine appointment. And Jesus asked them a question. He said, “Can you drink the cup that I drink from? Can you sit where I sit? Can you drink the cup that I am about to drink from?” The word ‘ cup’ is an idiom in Hebrew and means value. This means costs.

Please write it down. What does cup mean? Cost. That is why in the Garden of Gethsemane, when He was speaking about the struggle for the price of the cross, He said, “Can you take this cup from Me?” And he was saying, " Do I have to pay this price for them?" He was talking about the value of something. He said, “ With every position of leadership comes a cup. I am not against you wanting to be great. I am against you not wanting to drink from the cup. Ordinary people want a shortcut to greatness.”

And then he did a very strange thing. He then started a seminar on leadership. Because he understood that the other 12 were angry. The other two were misguided and each sought power. They wanted to be great. And so he made that statement. He said, "They said, 'Yes, we can drink the cup.'" He said, " You will indeed drink from my cup, but you will not drink my cup. You will taste death like me. " And so it happened. James and John were killed in a very gruesome manner.

He said, “ But to sit on my right and left is not mine to give.” I have something very important to tell you. You cannot pray for leadership. Clearly, there is one prayer that Jesus cannot answer. I repeat. He said, “It is not for me to give anyone the right to sit on my right or left. ” What did they want? Leadership positions. You cannot pray for Jesus to give you a leadership position. It's a prayer he says he can't answer. I know you have been taught that Jesus can do everything.

But according to Jesus, there is one thing he cannot do. He cannot give you the leadership position you seek. Very important. So no matter how much you fast and pray for someone else's position, God can never give it to you. Why? He answered the next question. "These positions belong to those for whom they were created, " he said. That was his answer. In other words, there is a place for everyone in leadership. And no one can take your place. Everyone say ' be included'. Say it out loud. What a beautiful word.

Being included means that no matter what they try to do, they can never be like you. And under God's leadership, they can never take your place. Very important. He was destroying jealousy, competition, suspicion, fear, jockeying for position, intrigue—these are the things you do. And then he said this. I like it very much. And I'm going to write a book on this whole project next year. He said, "Whoever wants to be great." In other words, if you want to be great, let me tell you how.

He did not rebuke their desire to be great. To be honest, he liked it. So much so that he even showed them how to achieve it. This is a shock. You need to think about it. Christianity has taught most of you that you should not aspire to be great. Because religion always goes against greatness. What bothers you about religion? This is why you pretend so well. You pretend to be humble, but you want to be great. And I have come to free you from this false humility. It's okay to have the desire to be a leader.

He loved their desire. To be honest, let me tell you something that might surprise you. Most of you think that James and John's attitude was wrong. I disagree with you. Because Jesus doesn't agree with you. If you examine his relationship with his team— the three people he chose as his close associates, the ones he revealed his secrets to, the ones he kept to himself when no one else was with him, the ones he took to private, those were the three who always spoke out, seeking power. He loved it.

And he also showed them how to get it. He said, " If you want to be great, this is how it will be." And he told them a secret. He said, "If you want to be great, you must be the servant of others and the slave of others." He said, “ For you know that the Romans, the Gentiles, the people of this world, their system of leadership is that they lord it over one another. And they make people benevolent. It will not be so among you.

” He was separating the philosophy of world leadership from the philosophy of state leadership. He said, “ They used to dominate each other in the world. ” Everyone say, "Lordship." Mastery. Please write the word 'Lord'. Lord. Now, let me tell you what this word means. It means owner. They like to treat people as if they were their property. Don't feel bad. It also exists in the church. Some priests are truly Roman. I don't want you to go to that church across the street. Okay.

I don't want you to join the worship there. I don't want you to go to that seminar. This is mastery. Peter received a lesson from Jesus that day. Because if you read the book of 1 Peter, when he was talking about shepherds, he said, "Shepherds, do not lord it over the flock of God." They are not your property. If they want to leave, they can leave. Oh! If you are disappointed by people leaving your organization, you are not a true leader. Because leadership has nothing to do with people.

He said, " If you want to be great, don't focus on people." You will focus on serving them something. So, greatness is finding what you were born to do, to serve this world. It's that simple. It's so difficult. I repeat, greatness, leadership, is found only when you discover that you were born to serve this world. This has nothing to do with the surname. Clothing has nothing to do with it. Praise has nothing to do with it. If you find what you were born to serve, we will seek you out. I want to say something.

You will understand this next year. Real leaders do n't seek followers. Followers seek out true leaders. And so he rebuked this philosophy that day. He did not condemn the desire for greatness. He showed them how to be great. Now, we talked about a topic, and I'll discuss that tonight. Please watch tonight's show. It wo n't be as long as last night, because I wanted to lay a foundation. But tonight, you will see tonight's show.

I want to explain to you a difference between the two things, and that can be found in the book, okay? I would like to recommend you to read this book because I cannot teach it in 3 days. It took me 30 years to write this. 30 years. But in this book, I talked about two ideas. Write them down. Number one is the spirit of leadership. And the second concept is the spirit of leadership. Leadership consciousness and leadership spirit. These are two different elements.

The spirit of leadership is what we discussed last night, and it's what you were born with. Each of the 6. 8 billion people on earth is born with a leadership spirit. The problem is, it's buried under Greek philosophy. For example, whenever this church called a leadership meeting, only certain people would attend. Most stayed home because they believed it was not for them. Greek philosophy is controlling them. Because they have a sense of leadership, but it is buried under false thinking.

And so that's what I have to do, and that's what this book is about. This book is not about leadership. Although it explains it in two chapters, it is about the spirit of leadership. Leadership spirit, I put it simply, is the nature of God that you are born with. Which is the consciousness of dominance. You were created to rule, to dominate, to control, to manage, to lead. That's why you want to be in charge. You were created for this. The desire for dominance is natural in every human being.

That's why you hate being indebted to people. Because the lender is always responsible for the borrower. And you do n't like to be oppressed by anyone. That's why you hate bills and debt. Am I right about this? Every person hates being indebted to other people. Why? Because it goes against their natural will. That's why when you are in debt to people, you become sick. You become depressed. You have a problem with your blood pressure. Mental stress begins.

And now your body starts to weaken due to all kinds of diseases, including cancer. Because you were not created to be oppressed. Isn't that right? That's why you want to be rich. Do n't lie to me and do n't show false humility. Every one of you in this auditorium and watching this show— every one of you wants to be rich. Am I right? Say yes. But you do n't want to be rich just for the sake of wealth. Your desire for wealth is to control the situation. I talked about this in this book.

The desire for wealth is to control your environment. You want to control where you live, what you eat, what you wear, where you fly, who you marry, what you wear, what you drive. You want to control how long you'll be out, when you'll return, whether you'll work or not, what to do if you don't feel like working. You just want to control life. Am I right? This is why you work so hard, yet your pockets are empty. Because you believe that if I work hard enough, someday I wo n't have to work anymore.

This is the desire for dominance. That's the real deal. My book on 'State', please read the book. Because in a very important part of the book, I talked about the desires of all people. Desire for power. People want power to control situations. I call leadership spirit the aspiration for greatness. What is lacking is leadership. So, let me tell you a little bit about what this book is about, and that is the missing link in your leadership development. Why can't people be leaders? Talk to me.

Why can't people be leaders? Look, the Romans did a pretty good job. They have forced you to accept second-class citizenship. You are afraid to aspire to greatness. And religion actually strengthens it. This is why I hate religion. Jesus did not say to the disciples, “James, you should not aspire to greatness. That is rude. John, I am ashamed of you. You want to be great. Why don’t you humble yourself at my feet, a sinner saved by grace.” He didn't say that.

He said, “My friends, if you want to be great, this is how it will be. Find your talents and use them to serve the world.” I'm talking about something deep here. Servant leadership does not mean bowing to the will of others. Servant leadership is a noble thing. This is dedicating oneself to the world. But first you have to discover yourself. Your talent is the key to your leadership. If you haven't found yourself yet, if you haven't discovered your true talent yet, then you are still a follower.

People have been looking for you all their lives and they haven't found you. They are only looking for what society has created. Yes. People aren't actually looking for you, they're looking for your talent. I'll give you a hint. Please do n't skip Wednesday. Let me give you a hint. Jesus ended the seminar with this statement. He said, " Whoever wants to be great among you must be your servant. And whoever wants to be first must be your slave. " What will you be? First. What will you be? First. Say it out loud.

First. Now, I did some research on this idea because I wanted to know what he meant? And the word he used was extraordinary. I say it in English. The first person they will look for is the slave. You do n't understand it. Let me give you an example. TD Jakes called me a few weeks ago and he said, Miles, I'm planning a cruise and we had a meeting with my leaders. And we were looking for someone to teach leadership, and your name was the first thing that came to mind.

When they want to get something done, do they think of you first? That's why you're not a leader yet. Because they don't know you yet. They don't know about your inner talent. Each of you is great. But it is buried under the cultural graveyard. Let me ask you a question. Do n't answer this. Just think about it. What are you known for? This is how he ended the seminar. He said, "For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve. Listen to me, and give yourself as a ransom."

Leadership is about finding yourself and then serving it to the world. What makes Tiger Woods a leader? He never sought followers. Look at him. And last month when he was playing, thousands of people went to that place and they were thousands of people walking on the green grass. This little boy is not even 30 years old. Walking. Why? Because he is leading. I came from London yesterday and his pictures are everywhere at the London airport.

I went to South Africa, and as soon as I stepped foot in Cape Town Airport, I saw his picture all over Cape Town Airport. He is not yet 30 years old. How old are you and they ca n't find you? He never sought leadership. He has never taken any courses on leadership. He has never done an MBA or any master's course on leadership or management. The man just found a talent. He discovered his talent. He has refined his talent. And now he serves it to the world. He is a slave. How... do I know?

Read the books written about him. He's on the course at 4 am and you're sleeping. You sleep too much. By the time you go to the course to see him, he's already played golf all day. He is a slave. Only the slaves wake up at 4 am to get ready for their masters. This is a little too deep for you. You can't be successful by sleeping 8 hours. It's that simple. Michael Jordan never took a course on leadership. He didn't take any courses on leadership management to govern people. He never sought followers. Found a talent.

He developed that talent. Read his book. He used to get up at 5 am before school. In high school. He would shoot 300 balls alone in the gym before eating breakfast. You were sleeping then. He is a slave. And you want to be great. You want to be great, find something you are a slave to. You don't want to know my story. 4 hours at night. That's it... I hate sunsets. Why? I have a lot of work left to do. Not now. And you are eagerly waiting to return home.

Most people are so determined to return home that they never get closer to their dreams. They are more worried about returning home than moving forward. Hey. Leadership spirit. The relationship between leadership spirit and attitude. The relationship between a leader's consciousness and his nature. You have the temperament, but you lack the attitude. I will briefly discuss 10 attitudes this week. Honestly, every attitude is a chapter in the book. I will talk about them in 2 days.

You know so little about these things. And these attitudes are what separate the follower from the leader. Or from a leader to a follower. And your job is to develop those attitudes. You are now sitting in the seat of a great man. The problem is that you haven't connected your mentality with your character. Jesus had to train those disciples to think differently. He had to destroy Greek philosophy. He had to make them believe that they were just as great. As Caesar. That was a difficult task.

He often said, "If you believe, anything is possible. " They didn't believe it before they met him. They thought they would be subject to the Romans for the rest of their lives. And Jesus said, "There is one here greater than Caesar." And he lived in a village. Look, it's not about where you are, it's about where you are mentally. Attitude makes the difference. I'm giving you some ideas that you can adopt starting tomorrow. The difference between a leader and a follower is attitude. Please write quickly.

What is the difference between a follower and a leader? Attitude. That's all. Attitude. I know it may sound simple, but it's not. I wasn't born the way I think now. I wasn't born this way. I had to go through a mental transformation. I was born into a family of 11 siblings on a small island, where I still live. I was an island-minded boy. 7 miles wide, 21 miles long. That was my house. I was born in a poor part of the island. I mean, I had all kinds of problems.

And I was born under the oppression of an imperialist power, who told me I was a hybrid human being. I had to overcome some obstacles. But last night I showed you some pictures of me, where I am advising different governments, training heads of state. How did you go from being a hybrid to training the president of a country? Something happened in my head. Yes. What is holding you back from achieving greatness right now? This is attitude. Attitude is more important than a college degree.

There is nothing worse than doing a PhD with a bad attitude. You don't become successful just because you are educated. Write it down. Unique attitudes are what differentiate leaders and followers. And it is this attitude of a leader that gives rise to behaviors that take him beyond the confines of conventional norms. Leaders always live above the general society because of their thinking. They never accept what you tell them. Leaders never believe in your limitations.

Because they have discovered a truth that teaches them to ignore all traditions. That's what makes them leaders. Honestly, the idea of ​​leadership is to leave the current situation behind. You can't maintain it by leading. I'm saying it again. You can't lead and maintain it. Leading literally means giving up something. That's why a true leader always breaks tradition. Because tradition is the graveyard of the hopeless. I want to tell you that what they have taught you is not true. Everyone, tell me your attitude.

Write it down. Attitude is the result of belief. Tell me. Attitude is the result of belief. See, the key to changing your attitude is to change your beliefs. And that is difficult. Because if you change your beliefs, your life will become chaotic. We do n't want to believe something we do n't believe in. We love to believe what we believe. And it is this belief of ours that is holding us back. Your current belief about yourself, which you received from your family, is wrong.

The belief you have gained from your education is wrong. The beliefs society has given you about yourself are wrong. And I'm saying, I know it's wrong, because if you hadn't fallen into its trap, you could have been even greater than you are now. That's why I was sent. You cannot live outside the boundaries of your beliefs. Tell me. You cannot live outside the boundaries of your beliefs. So you need to work on your belief system. Because it will shape your attitude.

That's why I tell you to read books and listen to CDs. No, we are not trying to sell books. We are trying to change your beliefs. And you can't change your beliefs until you have new information. Everyone, tell me you believe. Faith. Write the word faith. Let me just take a look... let me talk about this for a second, then we have to wrap up. I was just starting but we have to go. Everyone, tell me you believe. Faith. Okay, did you manage to write it? Faith? Did you get it? Trust, okay.

The word faith, I want you to write down the word that Jesus used, okay? In Greek, this is the word pistis. I S T I S. This is the word pistis. And the word pistis means faith. Okay, write the word next to it. This is the word we translate as faith. F A I T H (F A I T H). It's the same word. Faith. Now look at this. Everyone, tell me you believe. Faith. Everyone, tell me, trust me. Trust. Everyone say Pistis. Pistis. Well, you speak Greek. Good. Okay. Look at my words.

Trust comes, faith comes, and piety comes through listening to information. You hear what you believe. And what you hear may not be true. And that's the problem. What changed me was when I started hearing different information, like the one I tried to share with you last night that you completely ignored. And that is, you are gods. When I heard this, I was 15 years old. I was reading the Bible. At the age of 15, as a 15-year-old, I read the entire Bible in 1 year.

And when I read it, I said, "This ca n't be true because the missionaries never told me this." "I say you are gods. And you are children of the Most High." Psalm 82:6. I said, "Oh God, you put me in your class? And the British put me in the class of subhumans." Now I have to believe one of the two. Fifteen years old. And so the new information hit my faith. And he won. And my attitude changed immediately. I went from being a D grade student to an A grade student. With just one sentence.

I was no longer under the supervision of my teachers. Because they were from another country. They didn't believe me. You don't understand how deep faith is. Look, you ca n't live outside the confines of your beliefs. And so, what's holding you back from being the great leader you were born to be is that you still do n't believe the truth about yourself. Everyone, tell me your attitude. Attitude. Write it down. Your life is exactly as you think it should be. Skip lunch and buy this book with that money.

I challenge you. Your mother does n't know you. Your father does n't know you. Your life partner does n't know you. They don't know who you are. They only know about you as much as you've shown them so far. This is all we know about you. And we haven't seen you yet. Your life is exactly as you think it should be. So you have to keep changing your thinking. Know yourself. As a person thinks, so he becomes. So, we need to change your thinking. That's what these sessions are about.

True leadership is not a strategy, method, or science. It's an attitude. You can take all the courses in the world on leadership and still remain a follower. Companies spend billions of dollars every year sending employees to all kinds of seminars, and they come back as followers. Because you can't actually learn leadership. You have to discover leadership. You read all the books on positive thinking and still failed. Am I right?

You read the seven habits, the eight habits, the nine habits, and still nothing happened to you. Because see, this is what happens when you connect with a belief system that changes your belief system itself. We are working so deeply at this conference. What changes your attitude? Your leadership spirit comes alive only when you and I become aware of our true nature. And that's exactly what happened to me. And I hope that before this conference is over, it will happen to you too, that you will get to know yourself.

Who are you? You? When I discovered who I really was, I was free from everyone else's opinions. Most of us, including our families, are prisoners of people's opinions. You need liberation. Some of you are very interested in liberation. Freedom from Satan, freedom from darkness. No, you need liberation from people. From their opinions. A leader's beliefs and convictions govern the nature of his leadership. When their faith and conviction align with God's faith and conviction about them, suddenly a leader is born.

My prayer is that in the next few days, in this series, you will encounter a truth about yourself that will change the way you think about yourself. That is my hope. You are a great man and no one knows it yet. You are a great woman and no one knows you yet. And this world is waiting to be fed by you. The Bible never says that a person's education will make him a place in the world. Oh, what a fool I was. My parents would say, " Go to school, Dad. Get an education so you can get a job and be successful."

Now, listen to the instructions. Go to school. First, get an education. Whose education? The education of the oppressor. Then, take a job exactly according to what the oppressor wants. You are educated only to get a job. Never to become a business owner. Last week I was talking to my son. My son just graduated from Oral Roberts University. He has a dream in mind. You know, when my son-in-law and daughter were 9-10 years old, I had them write down their dreams, their goals, what they wanted to be.

At the age of 9-10. Because as children, we had to read books about purpose and potential at their house. So, by the time they were 12-13, they knew exactly what they wanted to do. So, they wrote it down and I have a copy of it in my file. That's what they want to do. My son and daughter. And an idea came to my son's mind. He wants to create something. He wants to build something like an amusement park in the Bahamas. The Bahamas does n't have that. He said he watches it every night before going to bed.

He goes there for a walk and does many other things. So, he came to school and started studying business. So, we were talking last week, because his MBA is starting in a few weeks. He will be one of the youngest MBA students at the school. He is only 20 years old. I said, "What will you do?" He said, " You know, you need to get some experience with a job." He said, " No, no, no." He said, "I'm going home. I'm starting my business." He skipped his job and went straight into business. His thinking is excellent.
